title: Third special sitting of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/20/2025/ޚޞ/3).

Report of the Independent Institutions Committee on its review of the President's nominations for appointing two members to the Anti-Corruption Commission under Article 4(n) of the Anti-Corruption Commission Act (Law No. 13/2008).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: This special sitting held outside the regular session (at 4:00 pm) was scheduled to take up the committee report on the President's nominees for two Anti-Corruption Commission seats and vote on it.
